claims.claim_text: In 2009, President Obama refocused U.S. efforts in Afghanistan on defeating al-Qaeda and denying it a renewed Afghan safe haven.
Because Afghan security was deteriorating, President Obama sent additional resources to reverse Taliban momentum and give Afghans time and space to build their security forces' capacity.
With allied support, President Obama outlined a plan to end the Afghanistan war in 2014.
